invariants.rationale: The method allocates a new ArrayList<WriteStatus> for writeStatuses, and always returns this instance, so result is never null.

meta.value: Method always returns a List<WriteStatus> allocated on the heap.

invariants.rationale: WriteStatus objects are collected from the JavaLazyInsertIterable into the result; only non-null batches are added.

meta.value: WriteStatus objects added to the result list by forEachRemaining; if present, they should not be null.

invariants.rationale: If inputRecords is null, then dedupedRecords is null, which could produce an empty iterator and thus result.empty.

meta.value: If inputRecords is null, result will be empty (because dedupedRecords becomes null, and so repartitionedRecords will be an empty list or an empty iterator.)

invariants.rationale: The result is an ArrayList; all Java lists have sizes >= 0.

meta.value: List sizes cannot be negative in Java.

invariants.rationale: partitioner is dereferenced (repartitionRecords, instanceof, getWriteHandleFactory) without null checks, so must be non-null.

meta.value: partitioner is used directly in the method body, so at this point before the return it must not be null.
